summary: 5/7 checks FAIL (A/B/D/E/G); bond_rigidity physically mismatched, network_dim lacks PBC, 3 extensive descriptors, zero unit tests

findings.issue: get_na_sites docstring says 'major species' but code uses na_occ > 1e-6 (trace occupancy); two incompatible site-classification rules coexist in same module
_effective_anion_radius docstring says 'weighted average' but code is unweighted arithmetic mean over species set

compute_framework_bond_rigidity numerator is M-X bond length, denominator is 2*r_X (X-X contact distance); ratio = 0.5 + r_M/(2*r_X), degenerates to composition descriptor; 'close to 1.0' criterion unreachable (actual range 0.55-0.74); fw_sym computed but never used
compute_interstitial_network_dim uses DFS (returns cardinality, not dimension); output scale caps at 2.0, never returns 3.0; len(sites)<2 returns 0.0 not NaN
compute_na_concentration counts sites not atoms; docstring says 'atom count' but occupancy weight erased by 1e-6 threshold
_get_interstitial_data 'with cache effect' is false; Voronoi recomputed 4x per structure
find_interstitial_sites volume field always 0.0, contradicts docstring
_safe_std docstring inconsistent with guard; ddof=0 never declared in docstrings; family_e:64 reimplements CV bypassing _safe_cv zero-mean guard
Three descriptors are extensive, scale linearly with cell setting (verified: NaCl 1x1x1->2x2x2 interstitial_count 8->64); measure CIF cell size not material property; structured system proxies
compute_framework_bond_rigidity physical criterion unreachable and degenerated to composition quantity (see A-3)
H unconditionally listed as anion with r=1.40 (identical to O2-); in hydrates/hydroxides H is proton (r~0), pollutes bond_ratios and poly_distortions
_shell_neighbors 'pad to 4' branch fabricates bonds beyond +0.70 window; docstring still says 'Na site' but reused for framework cations
compute_framework_na_distance_stability measures cell scale not local environment; coupling: no-anion shell excludes site from Na-distance stats
compute_framework_sharing_topology denominator is not total anions; periodic image overcounting path for small cells
compute_polyhedron_volume conflates Voronoi cell volume with coordination polyhedron volume
BVSE NaN degradation properly documented at module and function level
All distance constants confirmed in Angstrom and same scale as Shannon radii
Cartesian Angstrom and fractional coords not mixed; get_distance_and_image used correctly
Dedup threshold 0.5 has no unit comment; only bare distance constant without # Angstrom
Dimensionless ratio masks physical-object mismatch (see A-3)
Name 'concentration' implies volume density but is site fraction; docstring notes this
len(sites)<2 returns 0.0 not NaN; undefined and true-0D folded into same value; produces fake finite value bypassing README failure contract
_safe_cv([2.5]) returns 0.0; no len<2 guard (unlike _safe_std); single framework-Na pair reports perfect uniformity CV=0
Classification thresholds 0.3/0.6 systematically misclassify at small n; n=3 cannot reach 0D branch; boundary values deterministic but unjustified
Floating-point comparisons use bare <= without tolerance; only _base.py:328 uses tolerance
Threshold inconsistency: get_na_sites uses 1e-6 occupancy threshold, get_anion_sites has none
Bare except Exception swallows real errors (Qhull failure, MemoryError, import errors) into silent degradation; no logging; conflicts with program.md failure-recording discipline
Empty structures return NaN, no IndexError/ZeroDivisionError crash paths found; FAIL triggered by D-1/D-2 not by crashes

compute_interstitial_network_dim uses bare np.linalg.norm for adjacency; all cross-cell connections missed (verified: 46.9% missed at 7A cell, 30.4% at 12A); dimension underestimated; error stratified along system axis; 2/40 random cells had dimension label flipped
Periodic image generation correct: 26 translations + original = 27N points; nearest-atom check includes images
Dedup uses get_distance_and_image + 0.5A threshold (correct); LOW: greedy dedup non-transitive for near-equidistant triples
get_sites_in_sphere(include_image=True) and struct.get_distance use nearest-image convention correctly
Na+ Shannon effective ionic radii all 7 values match Shannon 1976
Anion radii mostly match Shannon CN=6; H=1.40 identical to O2- (suspicious, no source); N=None claim needs verification (Shannon gives N3- CN=4 ~1.46A)
Pauling electronegativity all 10 values match standard table; caveat: no framework cations covered (G-family would fail)
+0.70A rule cites internal part1.py not literature; 15+ free parameters, zero literature citations
BVSE dependency properly documented at module and function level
CN definition alignment with Shannon table cannot be verified in scope; no caller passes CN in audited files; if +0.70/pad-to-4 rule computes CN, 2-coordinate sites get CN=4
Zero unit tests for 21 audited functions; no test_* functions, no asserts; file is CLI wrapper only
Independence claim unsupported: imports parse_agent_args from train.py and prepare_structural_evaluation from automat_utils; shares entire code path with audited pipeline
Zero boundary-case tests (empty structure, partial occupancy, N-containing); these are exactly the densest defect areas
Random seeds fixed (42) at 5 locations; caveat: descriptor computation has no randomness, seeds contribute zero to descriptor reproducibility
Voronoi deterministic (Qhull, fixed point order); no PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent paths; caveat: no requirements.txt, cross-version reproducibility unprotected
False 'cache effect' claim does not affect reproducibility (pure function) but wastes compute (4x Voronoi per structure) and misleads readers
D-1 0.0 return path bypasses README 'all-NaN fails' contract; protection bypass undetectable by tests because no tests exist
